member_rule: Top-4 encoders by first-round mean VALIDATION macro-F1 (test folds not used for selection)
primary_endpoint: pooled OOF AUC, high (ISUP 3-4) vs low (ISUP 1-2), score = P(G3)+P(G4)

preregistered_comparisons.P1_encoder_vs_seed_diversity: late fusion of 4 encoders (seed 0, 4 models) vs Phikon-v2 seeds 0-3 (4 models)
preregistered_comparisons.P2_full_late_fusion: late fusion of 4 encoders x 4 seeds (16 models) vs Phikon-v2 seeds 0-3
preregistered_comparisons.P3_learned_fusion: mdrop4 seeds 0-3 averaged vs Phikon-v2 seeds 0-3 averaged

external_policy: Scotland excluded from training and selection; used later only to confirm locked comparisons
development_policy: Exploratory: Korean OOF test folds were inspected in earlier rounds
